blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover basic table and fragment recovery, one duplicate-priority case, unit conversion, invalid CRC/missing controls, sorting, immutability, and a Tukey boundary, but omit substantial documented behavior such as control-fragment recovery, most tie-breakers, quality filtering, control deduplication, multiple replicate medians, pairwise effects beyond one pair, analyte combinations, and many validation cases.

valid_failure_modes: The verifier performs apt and curl-based network installation of uv and depends on external package availability, so a capable solution can fail because of network or package-service flakiness unrelated to task skill.
